title: Optimization of pre-drying concentration and type of foaming agents to produce shelf-stable black mulberry juice powder using the foam mat drying technique
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00549C, Paper

Foam mat drying was identified as a suitable technological approach for the production of stable mulberry juice powder while preserving its bioactive constituents and their functional properties.
